content: Sony has canceled Fairgames, a heist game announced in 2023, according to Bloomberg. Fairgames had once been part of Sony’s big planned push for PlayStation live service games, but the company ended up canceling some planned live service titles, including in the God of War and The Last of Us franchises, and it shut down Concord shortly after its failed launch. The Fairgames cancellation won’t result in job cuts, and developer Haven Studios will now support other PlayStation studios, Bloomberg reports. The game was canceled following a recent test where “player feedback and retention results were mixed and fell short of the goals we had set,” according to part of an executive memo published by Bloomberg, which also cited “challenging market conditions in the PVP shooter genre.” Sony acquired Haven Studios in 2022. Sony’s live service efforts have seen some success with Helldivers 2, which is also available on Xbox. Bungie’s Marathon, which launched this year, has had a rough start, but today the studio showed off some new features coming in a December update, including a new co-op PvE roguelite mode and a PvP deathmatch mode. Sony is also working on a live service Horizon spinoff, but recently rebooted it.

chineseContent: 据彭博社报道，索尼已取消了将于 2023 年推出的抢劫游戏 Fairgames。 Fairgames 曾经是索尼大力推动 PlayStation 直播服务游戏计划的一部分，但该公司最终取消了一些计划中的直播服务游戏，包括《战神》和《最后生还者》系列，并在推出失败后不久关闭了 Concord。据彭博社报道，Fairgames 的取消不会导致裁员，开发商 Haven Studios 现在将支持其他 PlayStation 工作室。根据彭博社发布的一份高管备忘录的部分内容，在最近的一次测试中，“玩家反馈和留存结果参差不齐，没有达到我们设定的目标”，该游戏被取消，其中还提到了“PVP 射击游戏市场条件充满挑战”。索尼于 2022 年收购了 Haven Studios。索尼的直播服务工作在《Helldivers 2》上取得了一些成功，该游戏也可以在 Xbox 上使用。今年推出的 Bungie’s Marathon 开局并不顺利，但今天该工作室展示了 12 月更新中的一些新功能，包括新的合作 PvE roguelite 模式和 PvP 死亡竞赛模式。索尼还在开发一项实时服务 Horizo​​n 的衍生产品，但最近重新启动了它。
